source.source_name: GitHub Actions official docs: setting exit codes
source.purpose: Primary-source verification of GitHub Actions success/failure exit-code contract for automated learning workflows
source.cost_quota: free public documentation; no API key
source.reliability_limits: Describes process-level check-run status; does not prove that a specific lesson or model task succeeded. Inspect job logs and output JSON separately.

learning.title: Lesson-learner YAPAMADIM must not be a green GitHub Actions job
learning.claim: GitHub Actions uses an action's process exit code for its check-run status: exit code 0 indicates success, while a nonzero exit code indicates failure.
learning.decision: If lesson-learner attempts a lesson and returns status=yapamadim, exit nonzero while retaining JSON evidence; keep no-provider and empty-backlog skips nonfatal. Never count workflow success alone as applied_learning_ids or a completed lesson.
learning.next_measurement: On PR #356 HEAD run tests.test_lesson_learner and exact-head CI; verify failure returns 3 and no-work returns 0; after merge verify main read-back and a real successful lesson outcome. Baseline false-green run 40385437197 job 121792342924.

fallback_history: If the provider cannot produce a lesson, preserve backlog and record a blocked status; do not retry 401/403/OAuth/quota blindly or fabricate learning completion.
